subthemes.name: Understanding what's in images and video
subthemes.gist: Teaching models to recognize, locate, and segment objects in visual data—what things are, where they are, and their boundaries.

subthemes.name: Building and rendering 3D worlds from images
subthemes.gist: Making 3D reconstructions and renderings from photos and video, often using neural approaches that learn how light interacts with scenes.

subthemes.name: Connecting language and vision together
subthemes.gist: Building systems that understand images the way language models do, linking what they see to what they can describe and reason about.

subthemes.name: Making images and video with machine learning
subthemes.gist: Using generative models like diffusion to create or modify images and video, from new content to editing existing photos.

subthemes.name: Adapting and improving models for new situations
subthemes.gist: Making vision models work reliably when the data shifts from training to the real world, or when they encounter new domains or tasks.

subthemes.name: Making models faster and more efficient
subthemes.gist: Compressing and optimizing vision models so they run on limited hardware without losing accuracy.

subthemes.name: Detecting deepfakes, forgeries, and anomalies
subthemes.gist: Spotting manipulated or fake images and videos, plus detecting unusual or out-of-place content that doesn't fit expectations.

subthemes.name: Learning from limited or unlabeled visual data
subthemes.gist: Training vision models without needing huge amounts of labeled examples, using tricks like self-supervision, transfer learning, and learning from a few examples.

subthemes.name: Tracking motion and change over time
subthemes.gist: Following objects through video, predicting how scenes will change, and understanding temporal dynamics in visual data.

subthemes.name: Helping models know what they don't know
subthemes.gist: Building systems that estimate how confident they are and admit uncertainty rather than guessing when they're unsure.
